title: murtughas indica
intro: Murtughas indica, commonly known as the "Indian Murtughas", is a plant species used in traditional medicine. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestive health, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Murtughas indica include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily composed of flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
